Conservative commentators, lawmakers, and media figures are openly debating the political direction of the MAGA movement and questioning his administration's foreign and domestic stances.

actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: Javier Milei generated international diplomatic headlines during his visit to Madrid for the Ibero-American Summit by opting out of official summit sessions and royal receptions to hold an exclusive meeting with Vox leader Santiago Abascal. At home, Milei is confronting economic protests, security threats, and political pressure from internal coalition rivals like Patricia Bullrich.

Abascal is fiercely attacking Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's government and trade unions while competing directly with the People's Party (PP) for conservative voter dominance.

actors.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
actors.blurb: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro remains at the center of heavy scrutiny in Brazil after traveling to the United States to attend CPAC at Mar-a-Lago. Political opponents in Brazil are seeking to suspend his salary and annul his remotely cast Senate votes, while U.S. Democratic lawmakers are demanding his deportation over ongoing legal investigations in Brazil.
